text:
priya: Quick sync 1: we need a concise preflight + launch definition for Private deployments (VPC/on-prem). Field asked for one pager they can run through with customers.

ben: Keep it pragmatic. two sections: HARD BLOCKERS and SOFT RISKS. HARD = no launch. SOFT = launch allowed with documented mitigations.

toni: HARD blockers I care about (networking): no BGP/static peering established, mismatched MTU across path, customer firewall blocking egress to telemetry endpoints. add packet capture proof as acceptance.

sam: runtime HARDs: model binary loads successfully, kv-cache persistence survives restart, and manifested health endpoint returning OK for 5 consecutive probes. if any fail, rollback.

frank: packaging HARDs: checksumed offline bundle, installer supports idempotent re-run, upgrade manifests included, and uninstall path documented (we had an ungood uninstall last month).

priya: good. examples pls. I'll add them to the one-pager. also include "who to call" (owner & pager) and escalation ladder.

ben: for SOFT risks include things like no tenant canary wiring (ok to defer) and older customer BGP timers that may increase failover time. require a mitigation plan and timeline.

toni: field ops wants a short checklist to hand the customer:
- Verify BGP session established (show neighbor up) or static route tested
- Confirm NAT policy if IPs will shift (preserve cert SANs)
- Confirm ports open: 443, 10250, 9000-9010 (example)
- Run preflight probe: curl /health -> 200 (5x)
- Collect latency baseline: run 500 calls (p50/p95)

sam: add an automated script to run those checks and emit a result bundle that attaches to the launch ticket. call it preflight.sh. simple exit codes so CI can gate.

frank: agree. also include a small troubleshooting appendix with tcpdump filter examples, kubectl commands, and how to collect operator logs. customers hate hunting for logs.

ops-bot: :rotating_light: New checklist draft posted: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/cp/PRIV-Preflight (please review)

priya: proposed owners: eng-runtime = sam, field-ops = toni, product = priya, legal = ben (for contracts/audit). include owner contact & pager rotation in doc.

ben: audit note 1: include required audit events: deployment.create, deployment.update, key.rotate, user.grant, admin.login. default retention 90d, option to export to customer SIEM. add sample ELT policy.

toni: caution: for BGP peering we need to force a lab test with a mirrored AS path to ensure communities are preserved. add step and example AS-path prepend.

sam: performance gate: if preflight p95 > 2.5s for serving workload, mark as "needs tuning". we should let field proceed only if they accept higher latency or we tune.

frank: upgrade guidance: minor patch = rolling patch with automated canary 10% traffic for 15m then full rollout. major upgrade = staged canaries + rollback playbook, require dry-run in staging with customer's sample traffic.

priya: decision call: anything missing?

ben: add "network change window" requirement: scheduled mutually agreed 2h window and ability to revert network changes within that window.

toni: also add a quick Q/A: what is blocked vs deferred with examples. blocked= BGP down, MTU mismatch, firewall blocking telemetry. deferred= tenant-level canary, non-critical metrics retention tweaks.

sam: i'll add the preflight.sh prototype and the gating logic to the repo (GH: redwood/private-preflight).

frank: i'll add packaging checklist and uninstall steps.

priya: action items: sam -> preflight script (EOD), toni -> peering lab steps + packet capture checklist (tomorrow 10am), ben -> audit events + ELT policy snippet (EOD), frank -> uninstall + upgrade playbook (tomorrow). I'll merge into one-pager and send to customers by Friday.

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: All tasks logged in tracker PRIV-1234

priya: thanks team. i'll call this thread the canonical sync for the preflight definitions. ping me for any followups.
